fuente.titulo: Pope celebrates Mass on 400th anniversary of dedication of St. Peter’s Basilica

titular: Pope Marks 400 Years of St. Peter's Basilica
bajada: Leo XIV says Christ, not stone, is the Church's true foundation
caption: Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass marking the 400th anniversary of the dedication of St. Peter's Basilica, saying faith—not the building's beauty—is what truly shines through it. Source: Vatican News, Nov 18, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: St. Peter's Basilica facade glowing at dusk with its grand columns, a robed pope figure in the upper right third walking toward the entrance, left and center open and uncluttered
